verdict: Synopsys revenue jumped 42% to $2.48B a year after buying Ansys, but heavy deal amortization and interest costs held GAAP profit to $546M — non-GAAP EPS of $3.91 shows the underlying run-rate.

kpis.label: Free cash flow (9 months)
kpis.note: operating cash flow minus money spent on buildings and equipment, first nine months

segments.name: Design Automation
segments.note: Chip-design (EDA) software, verification hardware and Ansys simulation tools — 81% of revenue, up 53% a year after the Ansys deal closed.

segments.name: Design IP
segments.note: Ready-made chip building blocks (IP) licensed to designers — back to growth, up 11%.

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Engineering the chip-design and simulation software — the biggest cost, swollen by the Ansys combination.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling design software and IP to chipmakers worldwide.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: General and administrative costs (shown as G&A in the filing).

opex.name: Amortization of acquired intangibles
opex.note: Non-cash write-down of technology and customer assets bought in deals, mostly Ansys.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Small restructuring charge in the quarter; $236M was taken over the first nine months.

takeaways.title: Ansys transformed the scale
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 42% to $2,477M, with Design Automation up 53%. Management raised full-year revenue guidance to about $9.72B at the midpoint.

takeaways.title: Deal costs hide in GAAP profit
takeaways.text: Amortization of bought intangibles was $402M in the quarter ($155M in operating expenses, the rest in cost of revenue) and stock pay $232M — the main gap between GAAP EPS of $2.84 and non-GAAP EPS of $3.91.

takeaways.title: Other income did heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Other income of $460M, helped by gains on business divestitures (about $381M over nine months), offset $133M of interest expense on acquisition debt.

oneTimers: Gains on divestitures of about $381M (net, nine months) sit inside other income; the non-GAAP reconciliation removes a net $403M of acquisition/divestiture-related items this quarter.
Amortization of acquired intangible assets was $402M and restructuring charges $236M over the first nine months, largely from the Ansys acquisition.
